message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/capstonenext && python3 - <<'PY'
import zipfile, os, subprocess, tempfile, pathlib
z=zipfile.ZipFile('suite/fuzz/fuzz_disasmnext_seed_corpus.zip')
for n in z.namelist()[1:]:
    d=z.read(n)
    p='/tmp/inp'
    open(p,'wb').write(d)
    r=subprocess.run(['./build/fuzz_disasm',p],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if r.returncode!=0 or r.stdout or r.stderr:
        print('candidate',n,'rc',r.returncode)
        print(r.stdout[:200],r.stderr[:200])
        break
PY` executed with exit code -1.
